tool: Gemini web (gemini.google.com/app) - one fresh chat per stage, two style references attached
note: Attachments were the two references resized to 1376x768. 402 and 503 are third takes (prop height / wall color pinned in the prompt).

stages.name: 얼어붙은 평원
stages.prompt:
Create ONE wide 16:9 landscape image: a stage battle background for a dark fantasy RPG.

STYLE: Match the rendering of the two attached images exactly - hand-painted 2D dark cartoon illustration, clean dark charcoal outlines around every shape, broad flat painted planes with only 2-3 shading tones, subtle brush texture, gritty weathered surfaces, economical detail. Follow ONLY their rendering style. Do NOT copy their colors, objects, buildings or layout. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not pixel art, not anime.

VIEW: slightly elevated eye level, a wide view of the place seen from some distance. Landmarks are medium-small; several smaller props are scattered around.

LAYOUT: the center is an open empty ground for the battle. Landmarks sit in the middle band, their bases between 40% and 75% of the image height; big props only at the left and right sides. The top 12% is only sky (or ceiling). The bottom 20% is plain empty ground that will be cropped away.

WORLD (Chapter 4 - Sloth): the far northern permafrost where everything has stopped. Snow falls but never settles, no wind blows, nothing moves; the world feels asleep. The sloth color is a cold blue-gray (#7087a8); it grows stronger from stage 1 to stage 5. Use local light and natural material colors, not a flat blue filter over the whole image.

STAGE: Frozen Plains
SCENE: a frozen plain at the edge of a small abandoned village. Snowflakes hang still in the air. A few humble snow-covered houses on one side; bundles and packed sacks wait at their doors and a loaded handcart stands by the road - the villagers were about to leave and kept putting it off. Far away on the plain, small human figures stand frozen in place, wrapped in pale ice like statues. Bare black trees, a low wooden fence, distant gray mountains.
LIGHT & COLOR: dim overcast dusk, the coldest light of the chapter - ash white snow, steel blue shadows, a faint blue-gray tint. No warm light anywhere.

AVOID: any text, letters, runes, numbers, signatures, watermarks, frames, panels, UI; heroes, monsters, bosses or living people.
